prompt: What is the living cost in Redmond? I will be living at the Microsoft Redmond campus.  I don't have a car and I will rent an apartment. Please list the possible living costs in details.
response: Living costs in Redmond can vary, but generally, you can expect to pay around $1,500 to $2,000 per month for a one-bedroom apartment. Utilities, including electricity and internet, are usually around $100 to $150 per month. Since you don't have a car, you won't need to worry about insurance or maintenance costs. Public transportation is convenient, and a monthly pass costs around $60. Eating out frequently can be expensive, so budgeting around $300 to $400 per month for food is reasonable.
